lessons.title: Export files need a trailing newline
lessons.text: In notes-export, the importer rejects a Markdown export that does not end with a single trailing newline. Any function that writes an export file must end the content with a newline character.

lessons.title: Notes created in the same millisecond
lessons.text: In notes-export, notes imported in bulk share one createdAt value. Sorting by createdAt alone gives an unstable order; break ties with the note id. This was the cause of the earlier 'export order changes between runs' report.
